title: Declining to repeat a Tony Bennett and Hibbler story
summary: He declines to tell a story he only heard secondhand.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Well I have an inside source who, I don’t know if you want to pursue this story or not, but something that happened with Tony Bennett and Al Hibbler?
I know the story but I wasn’t there, I only heard it third or fourth-hand so I don’t want to repeat that. Would you mind if we didn’t do that?
I think you should talk to — who was on that gig — it would be Paul Langosch I think. If you know Paul Langosch I would contact him. I think it was Paul. I don’t want to go there. Especially today.
Yeah, you know jazz myths get spread around too much so —
Yeah I’ve heard that story. Sorry audience.
